Description: Organising and running the twelve-month programme for fifteen participants: five workshops (28 hours in total), the support hours between them, and the hands-on work taking each participant's dataset to a published FAIR data package. 15 places x CHF 2,000.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Eligible as conferences and workshop organisation under footnote 4 of the call's budget annex. It is not a salary or personnel cost, which are not eligible; it is the cost of delivering the training service. The deliverable is fifteen trained researchers and fifteen published, citable data packages with DOIs.

Description: Full-day workshop on organisational change for open science, delivered by Greg Wilson, author of Organisational Change for Open Science. Scheduled between mid-September and early October 2027.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Trains the applicants and the cohort together in the methods needed to embed FAIR practice in research groups. This is what turns a set of published data packages into a lasting change of practice, and the applicants carry the method into later cohorts and their Data Stewardship Network work. Placed late in the project so the cohort has published data packages to build the change work on.

Description: Travel for the external instructor to Zurich.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Required to deliver the full-day organisational change workshop on site. Travel is eligible under footnote 1 of the call's budget annex.

Description: Three nights of accommodation in Zurich for the external instructor.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Required to deliver the full-day workshop on site. Three nights covers arrival, the workshop day, and departure.

Description: Villa Hatt venue hire for the eight-hour agentic AI workflows workshop (full day).
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: An off-site full-day venue suits the eight-hour hands-on format, where the cohort works on their own data for a full day. The three four-hour workshops are hosted at ETH Zurich at no venue cost.

Description: Villa Hatt venue hire for the full-day organisational change workshop.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: A second full-day off-site booking for the cohort-wide organisational change workshop with the external instructor. Separate from the agentic AI workshop booking; the two are held at different points in the project.

Description: Catering for all five workshops: 16 people x CHF 30 per workshop x 5 workshops.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Catering keeps a cohort of fifteen participants plus instructors on site and working through each session, which the hands-on format depends on. Covers the two full-day Villa Hatt workshops and the three four-hour workshops at ETH.

Description: Claude Code seats for the cohort: 15 seats x 6 months x CHF 100 per seat per month.
Institution: ETH Zurich, Global Health Engineering, D-MAVT
Justification: Central to the eight-hour agentic AI workflows workshop and the support work between sessions. Operating cost is covered only to the end of the project, as footnote 2 of the annex allows for a project tool. The ETH Library lists AI-powered tools and services, but agentic coding tools there are unsupported: not managed by the ID CCR Cloud Service Center, no cloud assessments in place, use at the researcher's own responsibility. This line therefore does not duplicate a supported ETH service, and the conditions attached to unsupported tools are themselves part of what the programme teaches.
